envelope.description: Establish run ownership and runtime context

body.title: Establish run ownership and runtime context
body.summary: Add proposed scripts/test-harness/context.mjs contracts for canonical-root lease identity, runtime preflight, child environment, bounded budgets, run workspace and explicit recovery.
acceptanceChecks: Two checkout aliases contend for one lease; malformed/replaced/symlinked/abandoned records fail closed without PID/age takeover.
Unsupported runtime fails before mutation; nested child environment uses the validated Node22 binary, preserves explicit live opt-ins, and never leaks environment values.
Record transitions permit release only with matching identity and confirmed closure; unconfirmed cleanup or abandoned ownership retains blocked state. t3 integrates actual actor draining.

tests.name: Canonical-path contenders refuse overlap and preserve foreign/replaced/symlinked ownership
Unsupported Node refuses before mutation and child environment resolves selected runtime
Abandoned ownership cannot be stolen by age or PID absence
